values.quote: '''Illaoi''' slams down a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}}
values.binNote: Wiki leveling table only shows the passive Damage Increase percentage; the active's base damage-by-level and AD/AP ratios (9-180 base scaling by champion level, 110% total AD, 40% AP, further amplified by TentacleDamageAmp) are not present in the wiki leveling table text and are taken from the bin calculation IllaoiQ#TentacleDamageTotal. The exact per-level base array (9..180) is not spelled out in the wiki template.

mechanics.claim: Tentacle Smash is considered a Tentacle attack for Illaoi's damage reduction interactions, so using it at inappropriate times can reduce its own damage and following Tentacle attacks' damage.
mechanics.quote: Since ''Tentacle Smash'' is still considered a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} for {{ais|I|Illaoi}} damage reduction, care should be taken around {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attack sequences

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
